title: Building Floor Plan 3D Navigator with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an interactive 3D building floor plan navigator with time-of-day lighting control. The scene must meet ALL of the following requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera starting at position (0, 25, 30) looking at the origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.3) and a directional light representing the sun. The sun's position changes based on time-of-day (see Time Control).
- Create a 3-story building represented as stacked floor plates. Each floor is a 20x20 unit square slab (BoxGeometry, height 0.3) at y=0, y=4, y=8. Use MeshStandardMaterial with colors: Floor0=#cccccc, Floor1=#bbbbbb, Floor2=#aaaaaa.
- On each floor, place 4 rooms as BoxGeometry walls (height 3.5, wall thickness 0.15). Room layout per floor: Room A (x:-7.5 to -0.5, z:-7.5 to -0.5), Room B (x:0.5 to 7.5, z:-7.5 to -0.5), Room C (x:-7.5 to -0.5, z:0.5 to 7.5), Room D (x:0.5 to 7.5, z:0.5 to 7.5). Walls are MeshStandardMaterial color #888888. Each room has a door opening (gap in one wall, width 1.5 units).
- Add a ground plane at y=-0.5 (PlaneGeometry 60x60, color #556b2f).
- Use OrbitControls for camera interaction.

## Floor Selection & Isolation
- Provide 3 DOM buttons labeled 'Floor 1', 'Floor 2', 'Floor 3' and an 'All Floors' button in a panel at top-left.
- Clicking a floor button isolates that floor: the selected floor and its rooms become fully visible (opacity 1.0), other floors become semi-transparent (opacity 0.15) with material.transparent=true. The camera smoothly animates (over 0.5s using a lerp or tween) to focus on the selected floor's center at an appropriate height.
- Clicking 'All Floors' restores all floors to full opacity and resets camera to the initial position.
- Keyboard shortcuts: keys '1','2','3' select floors, '0' selects all.

## Room Highlighting & Info Panel
- Implement raycasting on mouse click. When a room's walls or floor area is clicked, highlight that room by changing its wall material emissive color to #ffaa00 (emissiveIntensity 0.4). Only one room can be highlighted at a time; clicking another room un-highlights the previous one.
- Display a DOM info panel (bottom-right, 220x150px, semi-transparent background) showing: room name (e.g., 'Floor 2 - Room C'), room area in square units (calculated from dimensions), and current illumination level (a computed value based on sun angle, 0.0-1.0 range, 2 decimal places).
- Clicking empty space deselects any highlighted room and clears the info panel.

## Time-of-Day Control
- Add a horizontal slider (range input) at the bottom-center labeled 'Time of Day' with range 0-24 (step 0.5), default value 12.
- The slider controls the sun (directional light) position: the sun orbits in the XY plane. At hour=6 sun is at (30,0,0), hour=12 at (0,30,0), hour=18 at (-30,0,0). Between hours 0-5 and 19-24 the sun is below horizon (y<0) and directional light intensity drops to 0. During hours 6-18, intensity = sin((hour-6)/12 * PI). The ambient light intensity should be 0.1 + 0.2 * sunIntensity.
- The scene background color should interpolate: night (#0a0a2e) when sun below horizon, dawn/dusk (#ff7733) near horizon, day (#87ceeb) at peak.

## Measurement Tool
- Add a 'Measure' toggle button in the top-right. When active, clicking two points on any floor surface places markers (small spheres, radius 0.2, color red) and draws a line between them. Display the Euclidean distance in a floating DOM label near the midpoint. Only one measurement can be active at a time; starting a new measurement removes the old one.
- Press 'Escape' to cancel an in-progress measurement (remove first marker if only one placed) and deactivate measure mode.

## Undo/Redo System
- Implement an undo/redo stack for the following actions: floor selection changes, room highlight changes, time slider changes, measurement placements.
- Ctrl+Z triggers undo, Ctrl+Y triggers redo.
- The stack should hold up to 20 actions.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
  - `currentFloor`: number (0=all, 1-3 for isolated floor)
  - `selectedRoom`: string or null (e.g., 'F2_RoomC')
  - `timeOfDay`: number (0-24)
  - `sunPosition`: {x, y, z} (sun directional light position)
  - `sunIntensity`: number (0-1)
  - `ambientIntensity`: number
  - `backgroundColor`: string (hex)
  - `floorOpacities`: [number, number, number] (opacity of each floor's elements)
  - `highlightedEmissive`: number (emissive intensity of highlighted room, 0 if none)
  - `cameraPosition`: {x, y, z}
  - `measureMode`: boolean
  - `measurePoints`: array of {x, y, z} (0, 1, or 2 points)
  - `measureDistance`: number or null
  - `undoStackSize`: number
  - `redoStackSize`: number
  - `roomInfo`: {name: string, area: number, illumination: number} or null
  - `totalFloors`: number (always 3)
  - `roomsPerFloor`: number (always 4)
  - `frameCount`: number (incremented each frame)

Ensure all materials use MeshStandardMaterial. All DOM elements must have clear IDs: btn-floor-1, btn-floor-2, btn-floor-3, btn-all-floors, btn-measure, slider-time, info-panel, measure-label. The scene must be responsive and fill the viewport.
physics_constraints: Sun position must follow circular orbit: x=30*cos((hour-6)/12*PI), y=30*sin((hour-6)/12*PI) for hours 6-18. Sun intensity = max(0, sin((hour-6)/12*PI)). Ambient = 0.1 + 0.2*sunIntensity. Floor opacities must be exactly 1.0 for selected floor and 0.15 for others (or all 1.0 when showing all). Measurement distance must be accurate Euclidean distance. Room area must equal width*depth of the room bounding box (7*7=49 sq units per room). Undo/redo stack must maintain correct sizes and restore exact previous states.
